This implies a cascade of interactions where Ent-Gloeosteretriol may influence the activity of the transporter, which then modulates the activity of Diacylglycerol kinase alpha. The presence of a high confidence score in the final_score indicates a strong, albeit indirect, link between the two entities. The mechanism is likely mediated through the transporter, which could facilitate the transport of Ent-Gloeosteretriol or its metabolites, thereby affecting the enzymatic activity of Diacylglycerol kinase alpha. This relationship highlights the importance of transporter-mediated interactions in drug action and underscores the role of molecular targets in determining therapeutic outcomes.
